parameters.content:
## 01 Input
Start the local Python bridge with `python -m scripts.local_api`, then click Execute workflow. The bridge reads `data/sample_leads.csv`.

## 02–07 Processing
A fixed HTTP Request to `127.0.0.1:8765` invokes the tested local Python modules: validation, normalization, deduplication, six-part ICP scoring, mock AI qualification, and safe final classification. No shell command or credential is used.

## 08 Output / 09 Errors
The processor writes `data/qualified_leads.csv`. This node checks the returned counts. HTTP failures or inconsistent results mark the execution as failed.
